verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents running the server on your own machine via pip, Docker Compose, or Kubernetes with your own LLM keys or a local model (skyvern-docs-42). Self-hosting runs entirely on your own servers and browsers (skyvern-docs-12, skyvern-docs-2), and Skyvern can drive your own Chrome (skyvern-docs-40). Together these cover local development without a cloud account. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of the local setup, and deeper docs on local-browser development workflows (the SDK docs default to a cloud Chromium instance).
